text:
alex: quick copy check — revoking API keys modal. Current draft: 'Revoke API key — This action cannot be undone. Revoke and notify.' Thoughts?

morgan: 'cannot be undone' is okay but a bit vague. Suggest: 'This will immediately invalidate the key and stop any services using it.'

sasha: primary CTA should be 'Revoke key' (danger). Secondary stays 'Cancel'. Also consider an optional 'Notify key owner' checkbox instead of bundling notify into the main CTA.

dena: accessibility nit: replace 'invalidate' with plain language like 'stop the key from working'. Screen-readers handle short sentences better. Also ensure the modal has role=alertdialog and focus trap.

alex: good calls — new draft: 'This will immediately stop the API key from working. Any services using this key will lose access.' CTA: 'Revoke key' (red), secondary: 'Cancel'. Add inline link: 'Learn more about key rotation' -> docs.

morgan: maybe add a very short consequences list (2–3 bullets) under the main line: '• Services using the key will stop • Scheduled jobs may fail • You can create a new key anytime' keep it compact.

sasha: UX request: keep modal minimal by default. Collapse the full consequences into a 'More details' disclosure to avoid scaring users. Also: show an extra confirmation checkbox only when the key has recent traffic > 1000 requests.

dena: if we do a checkbox, label must be explicit: 'I understand that revoking this key will stop services using it.' Ensure checkbox state is announced and that keyboard focus moves to the primary CTA after checking.

alex: for the success toast, ideas?

morgan: toast: 'API key revoked — the key is no longer valid. View activity' with link to audit log.

sasha: keep toast tone neutral: 'API key revoked' + short clarifier 'is no longer valid' sounds good. Avoid 'failed' or alarmist words.

alex: final plan: short primary sentence + optional 'More details' disclosure with bullets, optional traffic-triggered checkbox, CTAs as discussed, toast copy per morgan. I'll update Figma and the copy file, then ping for a11y review. cc @dena :thumbsup:
